abilities.name: Navigate
abilities.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
abilities.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation second.
abilities.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

abilities.name: Rest
abilities.function: Recover available physical energy at the current position.
abilities.effects: Base recovery 4, modified by actually accessible registered facilities; capped at 40.

abilities.name: Wait
abilities.function: Allow one simulation round to pass at the current position.

abilities.name: Pick up
abilities.function: Transfer a nearby ground stack into personal inventory.
abilities.effects: Requires actual distance within pickup reach; resource:ID means a matching nearby visible ground stack.

abilities.name: Eat
abilities.effects: Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

abilities.name: Gather accessible material
abilities.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
abilities.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
abilities.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

abilities.name: Drop
abilities.function: Place owned units on the ground.
abilities.effects: Other actors may subsequently collect the ground stack.

abilities.name: Give
abilities.function: Hand owned units to an adjacent actor.
abilities.effects: Actual recipient identity and distance required; no relationship or happiness is inferred.

abilities.name: Message
abilities.function: Send a short message to a currently visible actor.
abilities.effects: Delivered after the round barrier; recipient text is data, not authority.

abilities.name: Learn a public interface
abilities.function: Study an already implemented ability with its declared prerequisites.
abilities.costs: The interface-specific number of simulation rounds.
abilities.effects: Implementation does not grant mastery. Already mastered interfaces are reused without new rewards.

abilities.name: Request a capability
abilities.function: Describe an intended function and its conditions, inputs, costs and expected real effects for review.
abilities.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
abilities.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward.

abilities.name: Observe nearby nature
abilities.function: Complete an attentive observation of a reachable, personally visible natural plant or geological feature.
abilities.costs: Two consecutive stationary rounds, one energy per round, normal metabolism. Initiation requires energy >= 2 and satiety >= 4; each round requires positive satiety and one energy.
abilities.effects: Record one completed observation and its currently observable target state. No stock consumption, rest recovery, extra information or mental satisfaction. Incompatible actions interrupt without refund.

abilities.name: Arrange a small stone mosaic
abilities.function: Arrange owned stones on nearby ground into a persistent inspectable mosaic.
abilities.costs: Two to eight owned stone units, three consecutive stationary rounds at two energy each, positive satiety. Initiation requires six energy. Placement center within 0.65; offsets within radius 0.5 and at least 0.16 apart.
abilities.effects: Creates a walkable reserved mosaic after complete paid work. Interruption returns escrow without energy refund. No happiness or facility effect. Creator may dismantle using pickup(target=mosaic ID, quantity=all committed units) at ordinary pickup mass cost.
